verdict.rationale: API parity is a fair question for a SaaS company-formation and compliance platform, so the axis applies. The only API-related mention is a pricing line item, "Advanced API integrations," which describes connecting to third-party systems rather than a public API covering UI functionality. Probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt, and nothing shows formation, compliance, mail, bookkeeping or tax actions can be done programmatically.
